bricks.hint: The stop and the sticky support follow the last level confirmation, not your trade: honest alone or with LongBlock partners; for the entries of other strategies wait for stage 4c. Levels runs over the bars of the run window and re-arms the exited zone after a virtual stop / support break, so its events depend on the window start. With re-arm the indicator replays the solo class's position (no regime), not your strategy's position.

kinds.hint: PASS when the event passed on one of the last k bars
kinds.name: WITHIN

kinds.hint: Bars since the last time the event passed (0 on that bar)
kinds.name: BARS_SINCE

kinds.hint: X on the bar the event last passed
kinds.name: AT_LAST

kinds.hint: Highest X after the last event, up to lag bars ago (lag 1: the line as of the previous bar)
kinds.name: MAX_SINCE

kinds.hint: Lowest X after the last event, up to lag bars ago
kinds.name: MIN_SINCE

metrics.hint: Close in the channel: 0 = lower line, 1 = upper line; below 0 / above 1 = outside (ln close, lines of the tree after t-1 extended to t)
metrics.name: POSITION

metrics.hint: Slope of the channel in % per year (252 DAY / 52 WEEK bars)
metrics.name: SLOPE_PCT_YEAR

metrics.hint: Width of the channel in % of price
metrics.name: WIDTH_PCT

metrics.hint: Width of the channel in price at the bar: upper - lower
metrics.name: WIDTH

metrics.hint: Bars of the channel timeframe since the channel's start
metrics.name: AGE_BARS

metrics.hint: 1 when the level has a channel, else 0 (EXISTS in [0, 0] = no channel)
metrics.name: EXISTS

indicators.description: Simple moving average of the close over n bars of its timeframe (stored rows only)
indicators.name: SMA

indicators.description: Slope of the SMA over its last 5 values in % of the SMA per bar (stored SMA lengths only)
indicators.name: SMA_TILT

indicators.description: Internal bar strength: (close - low) / (high - low) of the bar, 0 = closed at the low, 1 = at the high
indicators.name: IBS

indicators.description: Average true range (Wilder) over n bars of its timeframe, from the first bar of the ticker's history; a distance in price
indicators.name: ATR
indicators.warmup: n - 1 bars of its timeframe from the start of history

indicators.description: ATR (Wilder, n bars, from the start of history) in percent of the bar's close
indicators.name: ATR_PCT
indicators.warmup: n - 1 bars of its timeframe from the start of history

indicators.description: Kaufman efficiency ratio of the close over n bars: 1 = a straight move, 0 = chop
indicators.name: ER

indicators.description: Relative strength index (Wilder) of the close over n bars, from the first bar of the ticker's history
indicators.name: RSI
indicators.warmup: n bars of its timeframe from the start of history

events.hint: Close crossed above a tracked zone + BreakBuffer x ATR
events.name: BREAKOUT_UP

events.hint: Breakout confirmed by a retest of the zone
events.name: CONFIRMED_RETEST

events.hint: Breakout ran away RunawayAtr x ATR above the zone
events.name: CONFIRMED_RUNAWAY

events.hint: Breakout held above the zone for BaseMinBars and made a new high
events.name: CONFIRMED_BASE

events.hint: The breakout failed: close back below the zone - BreakBuffer x ATR
events.name: FAILED

events.hint: Close below the nearest support zone of this strength (fully below the previous close) - BreakBuffer x ATR
events.name: SUPPORT_BREAK

events.hint: Close reached the nearest resistance zone of this strength (fully above the previous close)
events.name: RESISTANCE_REACHED

outputs.hint: 1 when the close is inside a strong zone
outputs.name: IN_ZONE

outputs.hint: On a confirmation bar: the setup stop (zone or retest low - StopBuffer x ATR)
outputs.name: SETUP_STOP

outputs.hint: On a confirmation bar: zone low - BreakBuffer x ATR
outputs.name: SETUP_ZONE_LINE

outputs.hint: Highest strong zone fully below the close - BreakBuffer x ATR (the sticky-support candidate)
outputs.name: SUPPORT_LINE

outputs.hint: Close above the nearest strong support, in ATR
outputs.name: DIST_SUPPORT_ATR

outputs.hint: Nearest strong resistance above the close, in ATR
outputs.name: DIST_RESISTANCE_ATR

outputs.hint: Where the stop would be had you bought at this close (long side only): SETUP_STOP on a confirmation bar, else the support zone low - StopBuffer x ATR; read it as AT_ENTRY(LEVEL OPEN_STOP)
outputs.name: OPEN_STOP

outputs.hint: Where the initial sticky-support line would be had you bought at this close (long side only): SETUP_ZONE_LINE on a confirmation bar, else SUPPORT_LINE; read it as AT_ENTRY(LEVEL OPEN_LINE)
outputs.name: OPEN_LINE

params.hint: Strength a zone needs to be tracked (and for IN_ZONE / DIST_*)
params.name: minStrength

params.hint: Breakout / break-down line beyond the zone, ATR multiples
params.name: breakBuffer

params.hint: A retest touch: low within this many ATR above the zone
params.name: touchTolerance

params.hint: Bars to wait for a retest (only with baseMinBars 0)
params.name: maxRetestBars

params.hint: Bars in the zone after the touch before the setup is missed
params.name: maxDwellBars

params.hint: 0 = close above the zone on the touch bar, 1 = close above the touch bar's high
params.name: confirmMode

params.hint: Runaway entry without a retest this many ATR above the zone (0 = off)
params.name: runawayAtr

params.hint: Base entry after this many bars holding above the zone (0 = off)
params.name: baseMinBars

params.hint: Safety cap of the base wait
params.name: maxBaseBars

params.hint: SETUP_STOP below the zone (or the retest low), ATR multiples
params.name: stopBuffer

params.hint: Strength a zone needs to become SUPPORT_LINE
params.name: upgradeStrength

params.hint: Touches a zone needs to become SUPPORT_LINE
params.name: upgradeMinTouches

params.hint: Re-arm after stop / support break (class behaviour): replays the class's own solo position (no regime) and re-arms the zone it exited; 1 = on (default)
params.name: rearm

params.hint: With re-arm: the virtual position's take-profit strength (0 = none); link it to the axis of your RESISTANCE_REACHED rule
params.name: takeProfitStrength

position.hint: Position operands read the merged position at the start of the bar and have a value only in a LONG (FLAT / SHORT: the condition FAILs, NOT_LONG). X is a market operand of the run timeframe: a bar field, an indicator, LEVEL or a brick. Not in the screener, not inside a brick / WITHIN; a version with one is position dependent.

kinds.hint: X on the entry bar of the open long (seeded: the seed bar); 'in position' = AT_ENTRY(close) > 0; a % stop = close < AT_ENTRY(close) with tolerance -5
kinds.name: AT_ENTRY

kinds.hint: The maximum of X over (entry, t - lag], bars without a value skipped; lag 1 = the class's ratchet (the entry bar is not in the window)
kinds.name: MAX_SINCE_ENTRY

kinds.hint: The minimum of X over (entry, t - lag]
kinds.name: MIN_SINCE_ENTRY
